title: This is my dream world
content: I drew this with pencil so it would be easier to adjust, but some of it is pretty messy and my handwriting isn’t great. I’m going to try redrawing it in pen or Photoshop at some point to clean it up. But I finally drew my Mall World and wanted to share it. It’s so weird how some of the areas match up from different dreams, like the country road and the country town. I had to guess where the airport and school are located, but these spots make sense to me.
